question: What is the name of the National Tribal Migration Support Portal that was launched by the Union Minister of Tribal Affairs, Shri Arjun Munda, in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shram Shakti.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shram Shakti** is the name of the National Tribal Migration Support Portal that was launched by the Union Minister of Tribal Affairs, Shri Arjun Munda, in January 2021.
 
• Shram Shakti is a National Migration Support Portal.
 
• Shram Shakti is a digital data solution for capturing information regarding migrant workers.
 
• Shram Shakti porta**l **would address the data gap and empower migrant workers.
 
• It would link the migrant population with the existing Welfare Schemes - under Atmanirbhar Bharat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Union Minister for Tribal Affairs **Arjun Munda **and Chief Minister of Goa **Pramod Sawant** also launched Shram-Saathi, a training manual for migrant workers in Goa.
 
• To facilitate and support approximately 4 lacs migrants who come from different States to Goa, the Chief Minister of Goa has also launched a dedicated Migration cell in Goa.
